name: Panel
description: Side navigation: links in expandable groups that collapses to a rail, or a sheet on narrow screens.

items.description: Rows in order, groups nesting their rows; an item repeating an earlier value is dropped.

value.description: Value of the current page's row, marked `aria-current="page"`; `null` marks none, and an unknown value marks none.

defaultValue.description: Current row on mount when `value` is not set; read once.

expanded.description: Values of the groups showing their rows; unknown values are kept but show nothing.

defaultExpanded.description: Expanded groups on mount when `expanded` is not set; read once. Default: the groups that hold the current row.

collapsed.description: Whether the inline panel is a rail of icons, labels kept as accessible names; a sheet never collapses.

defaultCollapsed.description: Whether the panel is collapsed on mount when `collapsed` is not set; read once.

collapsible.description: Shows the button that collapses the panel to a rail; false leaves collapsing to `collapsed`. Default true.

width.description: Width of the expanded inline panel: pixels, or any CSS length. Default 260.

collapsedWidth.description: Width of the collapsed rail: pixels, or any CSS length. Default 60.

surface.description: `inline` shows the panel; `sheet` shows a trigger that opens the rows in a drawer at the start edge; `auto` is a sheet below 900px.

open.description: Whether the sheet is open; only a sheet surface opens, and leaving it closes an uncontrolled sheet.

defaultOpen.description: Whether the sheet is open on mount when `open` is not set; read once.

trigger.description: Element that opens the sheet, keeping its own props; text renders as a Button. Default: an icon button named `labels.open`.

aria-label.description: Names the navigation landmark and titles the sheet; an untitled sheet is named by its trigger.

labels.description: Strings Panel renders itself: `open` names the default sheet trigger, `close` the sheet's close button, `expand` and `collapse` the rail toggle.

behavior.pattern: APG disclosure navigation, vertical: links and group disclosure buttons.
behavior.stateModel: value holds the current row; expanded holds the open groups (on mount, those holding the current row); collapsed turns the inline panel into a rail.
behavior.rail: Labels stay as accessible names; a group in the rail expands the panel at that group.
behavior.sheet: Below 900px with surface auto: a trigger opens the rows in a modal drawer at the start edge; activating a row closes it.

Tab.condition: every enabled row is in the tab sequence

notes: The root is a <nav> landmark; aria-label names it.
The current page's row has aria-current="page"; groups are buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
width and collapsedWidth size the inline panel; the compact sheet is a Modal at the start edge.

whenToUse: Side navigation of an app or settings area
A narrow icon rail that expands
whenNotToUse: A hierarchy of data such as files (use Tree)
